notes.title: Local Storage Failure
notes.notes:
Hello everyone, in order to make the game run more smoothly, I switched the game framework from Nw.js to Webview2 in the latest version. But this also caused some players to encounter the "Local Storage Failure" error.

Generally speaking, this is caused by the low version of Webview2 in the system. You can solve the problem by downloading and updating Webview2 on the Microsoft official website.

Update address: https://developer.microsoft.com/en-us/microsoft-edge/webview2/?form=MA13LH
